outcome: Give Consulting / SI teams a working Bid / RFP Response & Proposal Automation Copilot capability on their own data — it cuts RFP turnaround from weeks to days.
overview: Tenders are won on differentiating content and lost on the hours it takes to assemble everything else. Past wins, case studies and credentials sit scattered across drives and inboxes, so senior architects rebuild boilerplate under deadline and winnable bids get a no-bid. This copilot works from a governed library of cleared material: it reads the requirement schedule, retrieves the closest evidenced answer, and drafts a compliant response with a citation back to the source document. The bid team owns every word submitted, and nothing goes out unreviewed. A four-week build on a real past tender shows turnaround compressing from weeks to days and answer quality becoming consistent.
